experiment.name: final_analysis_research_experiment
experiment.research_status: NESTED PSEUDO-OUT-OF-SAMPLE; NOT AN UNTOUCHED HOLDOUT

clustering.medoid_rule: minimum average within-cluster distance; lexicographic tie-break
clustering.uncertainty_rule: reuse each date's full-universe training-only calibrated radius and subset its uncertainty geometry to medoids

regimes.volatility_threshold: expanding median of completed trailing-volatility estimates strictly before the rebalance

inference.dsr_candidate_set: all complete core experiment strategy specifications at the fixed 5 bp scenario

limitations: The public ETF panel is survivor-conditioned and is not survivorship-bias-free.
Historical inactive/dead funds, terminal returns, and point-in-time classifications are unavailable.
Execution is a close-t approximation after the return ending at t.
Cash earns zero and Sharpe statistics are explicitly zero-RF/provisional because no validated full-period risk-free series is available.
Transaction-cost rates are scenarios, not historical ETF-specific execution-cost estimates.
The historical evaluation period was observed during prior project development and is not an untouched holdout.
Static asset-class labels are not point-in-time classifications.
Direct perturbation diagnostics use four representative rebalance dates for computational tractability.
Synthetic clones are controlled diagnostic assets and are not presented as tradable historical ETFs.
Deflated Sharpe Ratio is a secondary diagnostic whose trial-independence and return-distribution assumptions are imperfect here.
